approach: vm sandbox loads index.html inline scripts; perfect-memory player flips both cards of each pair through the engine's own flipCard -> setTimeout(checkMatch,1100) -> state must become 'complete' with saveBest persisted, per difficulty x 2 seeded decks.

issues.rootCause: index.html:419 'if(comboTimer2)clearTimeout(comboTimer2);' — comboTimer2 is never declared anywhere in the page (only referenced at lines 419-420; no site-level script defines it either). On the FIRST successfully matched pair the setTimeout(checkMatch,1100) callback (line 378) throws ReferenceError at line 419, aborting checkMatch before its cleanup at line 449 (first=null;second=null;lockBoard=false). lockBoard was set true at line 377 when the second card was flipped and is never released, so every subsequent flipCard returns at the line-370 guard: the game soft-locks permanently after the first match.
issues.repro: Flip any two matching cards; both stay marked matched but the board never unlocks; no further card can be flipped until page reload.
issues.note: Same defect class as the engine's own documented 'Bug #23' (overlay undefined -> checkMatch aborted -> lockBoard stuck) at lines 253-255; that one was fixed, comboTimer2 was not.
